command_line: [ -f /usr/local/ssl/cacert.pem ] && export SSL_CERT_FILE="/usr/local/ssl/cacert.pem";  datasets download gene symbol 'SHH' --ortholog 'Pan troglodytes,Macaca mulatta,Pan paniscus,Indri indri,Semnopithecus johnii,Ailuropoda melanoleuca,Delphinapterus leucas'  --taxon 'human'    --include protein,rna,cds,5p-utr,product-report --no-progressbar  && dataformat tsv gene --package ncbi_dataset.zip --fields common-name,description,gene-id,gene-type,symbol,synonyms,tax-id,tax-name,transcript-count,protein-count,ensembl-geneids,annotation-assembly-accession,annotation-assembly-name,annotation-release-date,annotation-release-name --force > gene_data_report.tsv  && dataformat tsv gene-product --package ncbi_dataset.zip > gene_product_report.tsv  && unzip ncbi_dataset.zip
